method.grep: git grep -lE '<RX with NAME = module basename without extension>' HEAD -- '*.ts' '*.tsx' '*.js' '*.cjs' '*.mjs' ':!node_modules' ':!runtime/dist' ':!**/dist/**'
excluded: the module file itself (+ its .js twin)
runtime/bin/odg-v169-continuity-baseline(.test).ts (this PR's own runner — would add 1 caller to each module it requires, e.g. campaign-controller 16 → 17)
method.notCounted: string mentions in data/registry modules (e.g. 'odg-campaign-lifecycle.ts' inside a matrix) are not callers
method.static: callers are static references, not transitive reachability from a running entrypoint; live use is listed separately (observedUse)

callerClasses.MODULE: non-test file outside runtime/bin and scripts (runtime/core, src, app, lib…) — library caller on a production code path
callerClasses.ENTRYPOINT: runtime/bin or scripts file referenced by a non-test package.json script, deploy/** or a runtime/bin|scripts *.sh (a bin itself counts as its own ENTRYPOINT when so referenced)
callerClasses.UNWIRED_BIN: other runtime/bin or scripts file: the module's own evidence/demo runner or a manual CLI, wired nowhere

stateRule.CONNECTED_AND_USED: has a test (own *.test.ts or a TEST caller; all run here exit 0) AND ≥1 MODULE or ENTRYPOINT caller
stateRule.CONNECTED_NOT_USED: has a test AND only UNWIRED_BIN callers (named in callerFiles)
stateRule.IMPLEMENTED_AND_VERIFIED: has a test AND no caller of any class
stateRule.IMPLEMENTED_NOT_VERIFIED: no test AND ≥1 caller of any class
stateRule.DORMANT: no test AND no caller of any class
stateRule.PARTIAL (entry level): an inventory entry whose code modules do not all share one state
